--Business Copy 97928665956468
DECLARE @BusinessDate as INT = 20230116;

WITH UITF AS (SELECT SUM(TOTAL_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP)  TOTAL_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP
FROM [BUSC].[TRU_AUMUITF] WHERE  CONVERT(CHAR(8),ASOFDATE,112) = @BusinessDate
), 
NONUITF AS (SELECT SUM(AUM_IN_ORIG_CURR) TOTAL_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP FROM [BUSC].[TRU_AUMNONUITF] WHERE CONVERT(CHAR(8),ASOFDATE,112) = @BusinessDate)

SELECT SUM(TOTAL_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP) 
FROM ( SELECT * FROM UITF UNION ALL
       SELECT * FROM NONUITF
        ) A


--Banking Model 96138241044378.68000
DECLARE @BusinessDate as INT = 20230116;

WITH UITF AS (SELECT SUM(TotalBalanceAmount)  TotalBalanceAmount 
FROM [BNKM].[UITFAUMBalance] WHERE  CONVERT(CHAR(8),BalanceTimestamp,112) = @BusinessDate
), 
NONUITF AS (SELECT SUM(BalanceAmount) TotalBalanceAmount FROM [BNKM].[NonUITFAUMBalance] WHERE CONVERT(CHAR(8),BalanceTimestamp,112) = @BusinessDate)

SELECT SUM(TotalBalanceAmount) 
FROM ( SELECT * FROM UITF UNION ALL
       SELECT * FROM NONUITF
        ) A


--Data Warehouse 97928665956467.53000
DECLARE @BusinessDate as INT = 20230116
SELECT BusinessDateSK, SUM(AUMAmountFull) AUMAmountFull
FROM [DW].[FactTrustFundValue]
WHERE BusinessDateSK = @BusinessDate
GROUP BY BusinessDateSK
